verdict.rationale: The docs show two ways to control domains. The `site:` query operator restricts results to a single domain (e.g. `site:github.com rust tutorials`). Goggles apply custom re-ranking that can boost or demote specific websites and domains, and Brave describes them as 'custom reranking & result filtering'; they also control which sources ground LLM Context results. missing for 10: an explicit documented way to fully exclude a domain (not just demote it) or a dedicated include/exclude domain parameter, multi-domain allowlist examples, and independent or hands-on confirmation that domain filtering works as claimed.
